title: KOSMOS: Self-scheduling Persistent Kernels for Communication-Compute Overlap
abstract: arXiv:2611.07477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Tensor and sequence parallelism (TP+SP) and expert parallelism (EP) put collectives on the critical path of transformer layers. State-of-the-art fused kernels mitigate this with fixed roles or schedules, but this rigidity leaves large idle windows. Predicting a communication-computation split does not remove them either; a predetermined split cannot follow data readiness. We present KOSMOS, a library for self-scheduling persistent kernels whose workgroups use queues ordered by consumer demand to switch between communication and computation roles as data become ready, with no scheduler, per-call cost model, or tuned split. KOSMOS fuses every TP+SP collective of a transformer layer with its GEMM, and runs an entire expert layer, from router to fold, in one launch per direction. Evaluated on AMD Instinct MI350X and AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs, KOSMOS speeds up TP+SP end-to-end training in Megatron-LM by 1.10-1.28x in BF16 and 1.10-1.25x in M

translated_title: KOSMOS：用于通信-计算重叠的自调度持久内核
translated_abstract: 张量与序列并行（TP+SP）以及专家并行（EP）会将集合通信置于 Transformer 层的关键路径上。最先进的融合内核通过固定角色或固定调度来缓解这一问题，但这种僵化会留下大量空闲窗口；而预测通信-计算切分同样无法消除它们，因为预先确定的切分无法跟随数据的实际就绪状态。我们提出了 KOSMOS，一个自调度持久内核库，其工作组使用按消费者需求排序的队列，在数据就绪时即可在通信与计算角色之间动态切换，无需任何调度器、每次调用的代价模型或预先调优的切分方案。KOSMOS 将 Transformer 层的每一个 TP+SP 集合通信与其对应的 GEMM 相融合，并在每个方向上仅需一次启动即可运行完整的专家层（从路由器到折叠）。在 AMD Instinct MI350X 和 AMD Instinct MI355X GPU 上的评估显示，KOSMOS 在 BF16 精度下将 Megatron-LM 的 TP+SP 端到端训练加速 1.10-1.28 倍，在 M（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: KOSMOS 提出一种自调度持久内核库，其工作组利用按消费者需求排序的队列根据数据就绪状态在通信与计算角色间动态切换，将 Transformer 层所有 TP+SP 集合通信与 GEMM 融合，无需调度器或预设切分，在 AMD MI350X/MI355X GPU 上将 Megatron-LM 端到端训练最高加速 1.28 倍。
en_tdlr: KOSMOS introduces a library of self-scheduling persistent kernels whose workgroups use consumer-demand-ordered queues to dynamically switch between communication and computation roles as data become ready, fusing every TP+SP collective with its GEMM without any scheduler or preset split, and accelerating Megatron-LM end-to-end training by up to 1.28x on AMD MI350X/MI355X GPUs.
